content: Basi, maalongo bhangu, kiyaha tubhegha nahyo naghilo ahi, tuleke kutenda milando yoha yiihotola kutyong'aha mibhili na mihuki ya twenga, tuliyohe na tutame kwa kunhokamila Chapanga.
Maalongo bhangu tunguyupa mutuyitikile kwa myoyo yenu, tunhokela ng'obhe mundu ywohele, ebu kumpotoha mundu ywoheli hangi tunpugha ng'obhe ywohele.
Nungulongela ng'obhe milando ayi kwakya kuatosa mwenga ngati mmonekane ahakata, kiyaha handa panongelite kandahi, mwenga tungubhapala mumyoyo yetu, hata payibhele kwa kutama ebu kwa kuhwegha papamu.
Megha nalyogha ng'obhe panyobhela na mwenga, nungubhona uhwadali yakya mwenga, mu mapughwo gha twenga mokola kiuyingihwa mwoyo muno na uyelelo nkulu.
Patuhikite ku Mekadonia, tukipumulila ng'obhe, tukimokola mapungwo mumbande hyoha, tukibhegha na ngondo kwa panji na bhwaghalili mumyoyo yetu.
Peni Chapanga ywene yunakuapegha mwoyo bhandu ayoyoho, kakitutangatila twenga mwoyo pala pakahikite Titusi.

Hangi chepa kwa kuhika Titusi ghweka, ngati bhubho kwakya kumpegha mwoyo ghumunpeghite. Ywombe kakitughombela bhula panpalite muno kumona nenga, ngukuliko hyenu ngulu na kuyima papamu na nenga, na munntenda kila kilibhakwakya kndangatila, nnando aghu ghungunyeleha muno.

Hata handa lihamba linuatyekelite likiahyononeha, mona ng'obhe nnando ghwa kulibhayila kutyeka. Nungumanya kukita lihamba lila likiatenda mmeghe na kihyongololo peni ndo kwa nndaluko ghwa mandina ghweka.

Hinu nunguyelelwa, chepe kiyaha mukibhegha na kihyononeho, ngati kiyaha mahyononeko ghenu ghakibhatenda nng'alambule mahwacho ghenu na kulipetula. Ali ndo kakiliyegha Chapanga, kya habhu tukiahyononeha ng'obhe mwenga kwa kyohele.

Kubhegha na kihyononeho bhula pakapala Chapanga, kunguatenda bhandu aghalambule matamo ghabhe. Ali linguatenda bhandu bhalipetule na kumokola ulopohi, na hangi linguyegha ng'obhe bhandu bhalibhaye. Peni ngukuliko liiyambuhwa na milando ya pannima linguyegha kiho.

Nnole, Hihyoneneko hyene hinguhika kiyaha pakapalite Chapanga, kuatangatila kumokola milando ya maha, yingubhatenda kubhegha na kilyakalyaka kikulu kya kutenda ghanakunoghela, kulighombela kukita bhula ghamungatenda ndo gha hoto, kuukalalila uhakata, kunhokamila Chapanga, kubhegha na kilyakalyaka kya kummona, na kubhona kukita ywakahokelite kakingama ghanakunnogha. Mu agho ghoha mungubhoneha kukita mmegha ng'obhe na uhokelo mu nhalo aghu.

Habhu, payibhele nikilityeka lihamba lila, peni likibhegha ng'obhe kwa yula ywakahokelite, ebu kwa yula ywakatendelitwe uhokelo. Nikityeka ngati libhonekane pekupeku mu ulongolo ghwa Chapanga bhula pankakalikite kwakya twenga.
Kulyaghila twenga tukipeghwa mwoyo. Chepa kukita tukipeghwa mwoyo ghweka, bhubho Titusi kakituyeleha kwa uyelelo ghwakabheghite naghwo kubhukana na bhula patunnyelehite mwoyo ghwake.
Nenga nubhatika muno muulongolo ghwake, na munnando agho mukimbegha ng'obhe honi. Tubhaghombela uhoto manjubha ghoha, na ghala ghanubhatikilite muulongolo ghwa Titusi, yingubhoneha gha hoto ghweka.
Habhu, pala Titusi pakaakulungwa mwenga, kangughendelela kubhapala kyanalumu. Kangukulungwa kukita mukibhegha kala kunnyitikila, na bhula pamunkingamite maha kwa kunhokamila muno.
Hinu, nunguyelelwa muno kiyaha nunguhotola kuahyubhalila mu milando yoha.
